title: P-role1: dangling role references rejected
description: room-policy-04 §3/§6.6 do not say whether a referenced role index must exist. Readings: (a) allow dangling; (b) reject. Chosen: (b): RoleData::validate rejects undefined non-zero indices in authorized_role_changes and roles_that_can_share; index 0 keeps its §3 meaning (no role). Fail closed.
